summary.text: Jack Bailey is a Republican Maryland state senator from District 29 who has represented Calvert and St. Mary's counties since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Maryland Natural Resources Police officer, he serves on the Budget and Taxation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jack Bailey was born in Elkton, Maryland, on August 27, 1965, and graduated from St. Mary's Ryken High School in 1983.
He earned a B.S. in management from Johns Hopkins University in 2013 and an M.S. in management from the university in 2014.

Bailey served as a Maryland Natural Resources Police officer from 1991 to 2004 and later held positions including executive assistant to the superintendent and sergeant supervising the Covert Operations Unit, ending in 2017.
Since 2017 he has been an instructor and coach with the International Conservation Chiefs Academy.
Bailey assumed office in the Maryland State Senate on January 9, 2019, succeeding Stephen Waugh, and he advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026.
